```{=html}
<style>
/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Pair Notebook walkthrough — only the rules this one page needs.
   The paper, the pen, the panels, the buttons and the motion all come from
   assets/anim.css; the sequencer from assets/anim.js. Colours are the kit's
   resolved tokens (var(--_ink), var(--_accent), …) — never literals.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* ---- the two windows ---- */
.pn-win-term { --tilt: -0.45deg; }
.pn-win-nb   { --tilt: 0.35deg; }
.pn-win-title {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;
  font-family: var(--_hand);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
  border-bottom: 1.8px solid var(--_ink);
}
.pn-win-term .pn-win-title { color: var(--_term-title-fg); background: var(--_term-title-bg); }
.pn-win-nb   .pn-win-title { color: var(--_ink); background: var(--_accent-soft); }
.pn-lights { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; }
.pn-lights i {
  width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.3px solid rgba(44, 42, 58, 0.55);
  background: var(--_term-light);
}
.pn-body {
  height: 340px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem 1rem;
}
.pn-body::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.pn-term-body { font-family: var(--_mono); font-size: 0.78rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--_term-fg); }
.pn-nb-body   { background: var(--_paper); }

/* ---- terminal lines ---- */
.pn-line { margin: 0 0 0.45rem; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }
.pn-who { font-weight: 700; margin-right: 0.4rem; }
.pn-line-tutor .pn-who { color: var(--_term-tutor); }
.pn-line-you   .pn-who { color: var(--_term-you); }
.pn-line-sys   { color: var(--_term-dim); font-style: italic; }
.pn-line-cmd   { color: var(--_term-cmd); }
.pn-line-ok    { color: var(--_term-ok); }

/* ---- notebook cell headings ---- */
.pn-cell-tag { font-family: var(--_hand); font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--_accent); margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
.pn-cell-title { font-family: var(--_hand); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0 0 0.2rem; }

/* ---- drop box + photo ---- */
.pn-drop {
  height: 92px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-family: var(--_hand); font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--_ink-soft);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.pn-photo {
  position: absolute; width: 118px;
  border: 2px solid var(--_ink); background: var(--_white);
  box-shadow: 2px 3px 0 -1px rgba(44, 42, 58, 0.3);
  transform: translateY(-120px) rotate(-9deg);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.25, 0.6, 1), opacity 0.3s ease;
}
.pn-photo.pn-in { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-4deg); opacity: 1; }
.pn-photo-paper { fill: #fffbe9; }
.pn-drop .pn-hint { transition: opacity 0.3s ease; }
.pn-drop.pn-filled .pn-hint { opacity: 0; }
.pn-send {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem;
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
  font-family: var(--_hand); font-size: 0.8rem;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
  background: var(--_white); color: var(--_ink);
  border: 1.8px solid var(--_ink);
  border-radius: 14px 6px 14px 6px / 6px 14px 6px 14px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 -0.5px rgba(44, 42, 58, 0.4);
}
.pn-send.pn-press { transform: translate(1.5px, 1.5px); box-shadow: none; background: var(--_accent); color: #fff; }
.pn-send.pn-done  { background: var(--_accent-soft); }

/* ---- session record ---- */
.pn-rec { font-family: var(--_hand); font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0.1rem 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.pn-rec li { margin: 0.12rem 0; }
.pn-rec .pn-tick { color: var(--_accent); font-weight: 700; }

/* ---- the pointing hand ---- */
.pn-pointer {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0;
  font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.8, 0.4, 1), opacity 0.25s ease;
  z-index: 5;
}
.pn-pointer.pn-on { opacity: 1; }

@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .pn-win-term, .pn-win-nb { --tilt: 0deg; }
  .pn-body { height: 250px; }
  .pn-pointer { display: none; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .pn-photo { transition: none !important; }
  .pn-pointer { transition: none !important; }
}
</style>

<figure class="anim-stage" id="pn-walkthrough">
  <div class="anim-bar">
    <div class="anim-step" data-anim-step></div>
    <div class="anim-dots" data-anim-dots></div>
    <button class="anim-btn" type="button" data-anim-prev aria-label="Previous step">◀</button>
    <button class="anim-btn" type="button" data-anim-play>⏸ Pause</button>
    <button class="anim-btn" type="button" data-anim-next aria-label="Next step">▶</button>
    <button class="anim-btn" type="button" data-anim-replay>↻ Replay</button>
  </div>

  <div class="anim-grid-2" data-anim-canvas>
    <div class="anim-panel anim-panel--frame anim-panel--term pn-win-term">
      <div class="pn-win-title"><span class="pn-lights"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span> Terminal — you and your tutor</div>
      <div class="pn-body pn-term-body" data-pn-term data-anim-scroll data-anim-clear></div>
    </div>
    <div class="anim-panel anim-panel--frame pn-win-nb">
      <div class="pn-win-title"><span class="pn-lights"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span> Browser — your notebook</div>
      <div class="pn-body pn-nb-body anim-stack" data-pn-nb data-anim-scroll data-anim-clear></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pn-pointer" data-pn-pointer>👆</div>
  </div>

  <figcaption class="anim-note" data-anim-note></figcaption>
</figure>

<script>
/* The reference implementation of the animation kit: markup above, scenes
   below, and nothing in between. Everything the scenes call is handed to
   them on `ctx` — see assets/anim.js. */
(window.animReady = window.animReady || []).push(function () {

  /* Watts-Strogatz shape: path length collapses long before clustering does. */
  const P_STEPS = 24;
  const L_RAT = [1, .99, .97, .93, .86, .75, .62, .48, .36, .27, .21, .17, .14, .12, .105, .095, .085, .078, .072, .067, .063, .059, .056, .053];
  const C_RAT = [1, 1, .99, .99, .98, .97, .96, .94, .92, .88, .83, .76, .67, .57, .46, .35, .26, .19, .13, .09, .06, .04, .026, .016];
  const px = (i) => 24 + (i / (P_STEPS - 1)) * 176;
  const py = (v) => 78 - v * 62;
  const poly = (arr) => arr.map((v, i) => px(i) + "," + py(v)).join(" ");
  const pval = (i) => Math.pow(10, -4 + (4 * i) / (P_STEPS - 1));

  const scenes = [
    {
      label: "You start the session",
      note: "One command inside your assignment folder. Your tutor opens the notebook for you — there is nothing else to launch.",
      async run(ctx) {
        await ctx.say("cmd", "$ pi", 55);
        await ctx.sleep(500);
        ctx.flat("pn-line-sys", "starting notebook · opening your browser…");
        await ctx.sleep(700);
        const c = ctx.cell("cell 1");
        c.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "pn-cell-title", "Pair Notebook 02 — The Small-World Puzzle"));
        c.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "anim-caption", "Your notebook starts empty. You two fill it together."));
        await ctx.sleep(600);
        await ctx.say("tutor", "Hi! I'm your tutor for Module 02. Pen and paper ready?");
        await ctx.sleep(300);
        await ctx.say("you", "ready", 70);
      }
    },
    {
      label: "Your tutor asks — you answer",
      note: "All the talking happens in the terminal: predictions, explanations, guesses. Your words are logged verbatim, exactly as you wrote them.",
      async run(ctx) {
        await ctx.sleep(300);
        await ctx.say("tutor", "Four people in a room, everyone shakes hands once. How many handshakes? Guess before you count.");
        await ctx.sleep(900);
        await ctx.say("you", "6?", 90);
        await ctx.sleep(400);
        await ctx.say("tutor", "That's it. Let's put it on the whiteboard →");
      }
    },
    {
      label: "The notebook draws it",
      note: "The notebook is the whiteboard: figures, animations, anything the terminal cannot show. It is built one cell at a time, in front of you.",
      async run(ctx) {
        await ctx.sleep(250);
        const c = ctx.cell("cell 2");
        c.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "pn-cell-title", "4 people, 6 pairs"));
        const svg = ctx.svgRoot("0 0 220 140");
        const pts = [[45, 32], [175, 32], [175, 112], [45, 112]];
        const pairs = [[0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 0], [0, 2], [1, 3]];
        pairs.forEach((pr, i) => {
          const ln = ctx.svgEl("line", {
            x1: pts[pr[0]][0], y1: pts[pr[0]][1],
            x2: pts[pr[1]][0], y2: pts[pr[1]][1],
            "class": "anim-edge anim-draw"
          });
          ln.style.animationDelay = (ctx.fast() ? 0 : 0.35 + i * 0.28) + "s";
          svg.appendChild(ln);
        });
        pts.forEach((p, i) => {
          const ci = ctx.svgEl("circle", { cx: p[0], cy: p[1], r: 11, "class": "anim-node anim-fade" });
          ci.style.animationDelay = (ctx.fast() ? 0 : i * 0.09) + "s";
          svg.appendChild(ci);
        });
        c.appendChild(svg);
        c.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "anim-caption", "Every pair joined once: 4 × 3 / 2 = 6 edges."));
        ctx.bottom(ctx.nb);
        await ctx.sleep(2600);
        await ctx.say("tutor", "✓ Checkpoint 1 logged — in your words, not mine.");
      }
    },
    {
      label: "You get a knob to turn",
      note: "Some cells are live experiments. Turn the knob, watch what moves, and tell your tutor what you saw — that sentence is the checkpoint.",
      async run(ctx) {
        await ctx.sleep(250);
        const c = ctx.cell("cell 3");
        c.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "pn-cell-title", "Rewire a ring, one edge at a time"));

        const wrap = ctx.el("div", "anim-range");
        const track = ctx.el("div", "anim-track");
        const knob = ctx.el("div", "anim-knob");
        track.appendChild(knob);
        wrap.appendChild(track);
        const read = ctx.el("div", "anim-readout",
          '<span>p = <b data-p>0.0001</b></span>' +
          '<span style="color:var(--_accent)">path length <b data-l>1.00</b></span>' +
          '<span style="color:var(--_amber)">clustering <b data-c>1.00</b></span>');
        wrap.appendChild(read);
        const svg = ctx.svgRoot("0 0 214 96");
        svg.innerHTML =
          '<line class="anim-axis" x1="22" y1="80" x2="206" y2="80"/>' +
          '<line class="anim-axis" x1="22" y1="10" x2="22" y2="80"/>' +
          '<polyline class="anim-amber-stroke" points="' + poly(C_RAT) + '"/>' +
          '<polyline class="anim-accent-stroke" points="' + poly(L_RAT) + '"/>' +
          '<line class="anim-marker" data-mark x1="24" y1="8" x2="24" y2="82"/>' +
          '<text class="anim-label" x="22" y="93">p = 0.0001</text>' +
          '<text class="anim-label" x="176" y="93">p = 1</text>';
        wrap.appendChild(svg);
        c.appendChild(wrap);
        c.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "anim-caption", "Drag it and watch which curve falls first."));
        ctx.bottom(ctx.nb);

        /* Scoped to this cell — two stages on one page must not collide. */
        const outP = read.querySelector("[data-p]");
        const outL = read.querySelector("[data-l]");
        const outC = read.querySelector("[data-c]");
        const mark = svg.querySelector("[data-mark]");

        /* The knob really is a knob: pointer, touch and arrow keys all land
           here, and grabbing it pauses the walkthrough so it is yours. */
        const dial = ctx.mountKnob(knob, {
          min: 0, max: P_STEPS - 1, step: 1, value: 0,
          label: "Rewiring probability p",
          format: (i) => "p = " + pval(i).toFixed(4),
          onGrab: () => ctx.pause(),
          onInput: (i) => {
            outP.textContent = pval(i).toFixed(4);
            outL.textContent = L_RAT[i].toFixed(2);
            outC.textContent = C_RAT[i].toFixed(2);
            mark.setAttribute("x1", px(i));
            mark.setAttribute("x2", px(i));
          }
        });

        await ctx.sleep(700);
        ctx.point(knob, 0, 26);
        await ctx.sleep(700);
        for (let i = 0; i <= P_STEPS - 1; i++) {
          dial.set(i);
          if (!ctx.fast()) ctx.point(knob, 0, 26);
          await ctx.sleep(105);
        }
        ctx.unpoint();
        await ctx.sleep(500);
        await ctx.say("tutor", "So — what fell first?");
        await ctx.sleep(500);
        await ctx.say("you", "the path length crashes way before the clustering does", 34);
        await ctx.sleep(400);
        const n = ctx.cell("note");
        n.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "anim-quote", "“the path length crashes way before the clustering does”"));
        n.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "anim-caption", "— your answer, checkpoint 2, quoted word for word"));
        ctx.bottom(ctx.nb);
      }
    },
    {
      label: "You photograph your paper",
      note: "Three steps happen off-screen, on real paper: a distance table, a drawing, a derivation. Photograph each with your phone, drop it in, press 📨 Send to my tutor.",
      async run(ctx) {
        await ctx.sleep(250);
        await ctx.say("tutor", "Now do it by hand. Fill in the distance table on paper, then photograph it.");
        await ctx.sleep(500);
        const c = ctx.cell("cell 4");
        c.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "pn-cell-title", "📷 Your distance table"));
        const drop = ctx.el("div", "anim-panel anim-panel--dashed pn-drop",
          '<span class="pn-hint">drop a photo of your paper here</span>');
        const photo = ctx.el("div", "pn-photo",
          '<svg viewBox="0 0 120 84" class="anim-svg" aria-label="a photo of a handwritten table">' +
          '<rect class="pn-photo-paper" x="0" y="0" width="120" height="84"/>' +
          '<path class="anim-faint" d="M12 20 H108 M12 36 H108 M12 52 H108 M12 68 H108" stroke-width="1" style="fill:none"/>' +
          '<path class="anim-faint" d="M40 12 V76 M68 12 V76 M92 12 V76" stroke-width="1" style="fill:none"/>' +
          '<path class="anim-edge" d="M18 30 q6 -8 10 0 M50 30 q5 -7 9 1 M76 29 q7 -6 10 2 M100 31 q4 -8 8 0"/>' +
          '<path class="anim-edge" d="M18 46 q7 -7 11 1 M50 47 q4 -9 9 0 M78 45 q5 -6 8 3 M100 47 q6 -7 8 1"/>' +
          '<path class="anim-edge" d="M19 63 q5 -8 10 1 M52 62 q6 -6 8 2 M77 63 q6 -8 9 1 M101 62 q5 -7 8 2"/>' +
          "</svg>");
        drop.appendChild(photo);
        c.appendChild(drop);
        const send = ctx.el("div", "pn-send", "📨 Send to my tutor");
        c.appendChild(send);
        ctx.bottom(ctx.nb);

        await ctx.sleep(600);
        photo.classList.add("pn-in");
        drop.classList.add("pn-filled");
        await ctx.sleep(900);
        ctx.point(send, 6, 16);
        await ctx.sleep(650);
        send.classList.add("pn-press");
        await ctx.sleep(320);
        send.classList.remove("pn-press");
        send.classList.add("pn-done");
        send.textContent = "✓ sent";
        ctx.unpoint();
        await ctx.sleep(400);
        await ctx.say("tutor", "Got it. Rows 1–3 check out. Row 4 counts one pair twice — want another look?");
        await ctx.sleep(600);
        await ctx.say("you", "oh — i double counted B–D", 40);
      }
    },
    {
      label: "You hand it in from the terminal",
      note: "Nothing to upload by hand, no file to email. Tell your tutor you are done and it commits the session to your Classroom 50 repository.",
      async run(ctx) {
        await ctx.sleep(250);
        await ctx.say("you", "that's me done for today — hand it in", 34);
        await ctx.sleep(500);
        await ctx.say("tutor", "Handing in your notebook, your log and the summary.");
        await ctx.sleep(400);
        ctx.flat("pn-line-cmd", '$ git add -A && git commit -m "Pair Notebook 02" && git push');
        await ctx.sleep(900);
        ctx.flat("pn-line-ok", "✓ pushed to your Classroom 50 repository — 12 checkpoints, 71m");
        await ctx.sleep(500);
        const c = ctx.cell("cell 12");
        c.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "pn-cell-title", "Session record"));
        const ul = ctx.el("ul", "pn-rec");
        ["notebook.py — your illustrated lecture note",
         "session_log.jsonl — every answer, verbatim",
         "session_summary.md — for your instructor"].forEach((t) => {
          ul.appendChild(ctx.el("li", null, '<span class="pn-tick">✓</span> ' + t));
        });
        c.appendChild(ul);
        c.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "anim-caption", "Stopping halfway is fine — pick it up tomorrow and hand in again."));
        ctx.bottom(ctx.nb);
        await ctx.sleep(2200);
      }
    }
  ];

  mountScenes(document.getElementById("pn-walkthrough"), scenes, {
    stepsLabel: "Walkthrough steps",

    /* The four things only this animation has: a terminal, a notebook, a
       pointing hand, and the two speakers. Built once, handed to every scene. */
    helpers(ctx) {
      const term = ctx.$("[data-pn-term]");
      const nb = ctx.$("[data-pn-nb]");
      const desk = ctx.$("[data-anim-canvas]");
      const pointer = ctx.$("[data-pn-pointer]");
      const WHO = { tutor: "tutor ›", you: "you ›" };

      async function say(who, text, speed) {
        const line = ctx.el("div", "pn-line pn-line-" + who);
        if (WHO[who]) line.appendChild(ctx.el("span", "pn-who", WHO[who]));
        const span = ctx.el("span");
        line.appendChild(span);
        term.appendChild(line);
        ctx.bottom(term);
        await ctx.type(span, text, speed);
        return line;
      }

      function flat(cls, text) {
        const line = ctx.el("div", "pn-line " + cls);
        line.textContent = text;
        term.appendChild(line);
        ctx.bottom(term);
        return line;
      }

      function cell(tag) {
        const c = ctx.el("div", "anim-panel anim-pop");
        if (tag) c.appendChild(ctx.el("div", "pn-cell-tag", tag));
        nb.appendChild(c);
        ctx.bottom(nb);
        return c;
      }

      function point(target, dx, dy) {
        if (ctx.fast() || ctx.reduced) return;
        const a = target.getBoundingClientRect();
        const b = desk.getBoundingClientRect();
        pointer.style.transform =
          "translate(" + (a.left - b.left + a.width / 2 + (dx || 0)) + "px," +
          (a.top - b.top + a.height / 2 + (dy || 0)) + "px)";
        pointer.classList.add("pn-on");
      }
      const unpoint = () => pointer.classList.remove("pn-on");

      return { term, nb, desk, pointer, say, flat, cell, point, unpoint };
    },

    clear(ctx) { ctx.unpoint(); }
  });
});
</script>
```
